root_cause: powerhouse-blog-queue writes the daily blog obligation as GENERATED, and powerhouse-blog-export refuses any blog whose obligation has no approved_at or a status other than APPROVED, PUBLISHED or LIVE_PROVEN. Nothing in the repository moved a blog from GENERATED to APPROVED. The hourly powerhouse-daily-blog workflow therefore succeeded while publish_powerhouse_blog_artifact.py printed NO_APPROVED_BLOG_ARTIFACT, the candidate-PR step was skipped, and 21 blogs stayed GENERATED without an error.

observed_evidence.source: content_publication_obligations (21 GENERATED with approved_at empty, 18 MEASURED all with approved_at), GitHub run 42025233353 on 2026-11-05 (candidate step skipped, NO_APPROVED_BLOG_ARTIFACT:2026-11-05), powerhouse-blog-export source line 34

fix: tools/content-growth/blog-auto-approval.mjs runs as a step in the existing hourly powerhouse-daily-blog workflow. supabase/functions/_shared/blog-auto-approval.mjs decides: only a GENERATED row of the current Amsterdam business date with lineage, a publish decision, a passing official-date gate, no veto and an elapsed veto window of 6 hours is approved, through the existing record_content_publication_state function. Stale rows are never approved. Reader-ready, official-date and protected PR gates stay downstream.
prevention_rule: A generated blog needs an owner for the step from GENERATED to APPROVED. A workflow that finds nothing approved must not look successful: the approval step fails loudly on missing credentials or a failed write and logs a coded decision line.

invariants: official factual gate still blocks approval

open_obligation: Protected merge by Arthur, then the next hourly run must log BLOG_AUTO_APPROVAL:APPROVED_AFTER_VETO_WINDOW and the blog must reach LIVE_PROVEN. No notification to Arthur exists yet; a veto is set in obligation evidence.
reuse_guidance: Do not set approved_at directly in the database. Change the window or gates only in the shared module and its test.
